entries.title: A computer that runs your work names itself on its own sign-in rows
entries.body: In Settings → Intelligence, an account under a computer that runs your work now says its words of that computer. A Claude account there with no login yet reads "Sign in with Claude on iMac.", where it used to name the computer your first mate lives on, or this computer.
entries.noPicture: A few words in one line of an account row change; a release review takes a picture if this becomes a highlight.
